Loading saved analysis results and defining formatting functions

```{r echo=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

# Load all saved analysis results1

saved <- readRDS("industry_comparisons.rds")

analysis_periods <- saved$analysis_periods
period_results <- saved$period_results
comparison_metrics <- saved$comparison_metrics
period_comparisons <- saved$period_comparisons
comparison_plots <- saved$comparison_plots
comparison_tables <- saved$comparison_tables
data_list <- saved$data_list

Chosen_Stock <- "ULVR"

start_date <- as.Date("2020-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2022-12-31")

trading_days <- 252
n_simulations <- 500

stock <- data_list[[Chosen_Stock]]

all_dates <- as.Date(stock$date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
all_prices <- as.numeric(as.character(stock$close))

selected <- !is.na(all_dates) &
  all_dates >= start_date &
  all_dates <= end_date &
  is.finite(all_prices) &
  all_prices > 0

ordering <- order(all_dates[selected])

dates <- all_dates[selected][ordering]
prices <- all_prices[selected][ordering]

# Estimate GBM parameters
log_returns <- diff(log(prices))

sigma_hat <- sd(log_returns) * sqrt(trading_days)

mu_hat <- mean(log_returns) * trading_days +
  0.5 * sigma_hat^2

comparison_summary <- period_comparisons

period_names <- names(analysis_periods)


format_sf3 <- function(x) {
  
  vapply(x, function(value) {
    
    if (is.na(value) || !is.finite(value)) return("NA")
    if (value == 0) return("0.00")
    
    rounded <- signif(value, 3)
    
    if (abs(rounded) >= 1e5 || abs(rounded) < 1e-4) {
      return(sprintf("%.2e", rounded))
    }
    
    decimals <- max(0, 2 - floor(log10(abs(rounded))))
    
    sprintf(paste0("%.", decimals, "f"), rounded)
    
  }, character(1))
  
}

wrap_industry <- function(x) {
  
  vapply(
    as.character(x),
    function(name) {
      paste(strwrap(name, width = 25), collapse = "\n")
    },
    character(1)
  )
  
}

```

# Dividends

```{r dividend-comparison, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(quantmod)
library(knitr)

# Get kaggel and yahoo prices for BP
bp_yahoo <- getSymbols(
  "BP.L",
  src = "yahoo",
  from = "2024-01-01",
  to = "2025-01-01",
  auto.assign = FALSE
)

comparison <- merge(
  data.frame(
    date = as.Date(data_list[["BP"]]$date),
    kaggle = data_list[["BP"]]$close
  ),
  data.frame(
    date = as.Date(index(bp_yahoo)),
    unadjusted = as.numeric(Cl(bp_yahoo)),
    adjusted = as.numeric(Ad(bp_yahoo))
  ),
  by = "date"
)

comparison <- comparison[order(comparison$date), ]

# daily log returns
returns <- lapply(comparison[-1], function(x) diff(log(x)))

# mean absolute differences
results <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c("Unadjusted prices", "Dividend-adjusted prices"),
  Mean_Absolute_Difference = c(
    mean(abs(returns$kaggle - returns$unadjusted)),
    mean(abs(returns$kaggle - returns$adjusted))
  )
)

results$Mean_Absolute_Difference <- sprintf(
  "%.12f",
  results$Mean_Absolute_Difference
)

knitr::kable(
  results,
  col.names = c("Yahoo Finance comparison", "Mean absolute difference"),
  caption = "Comparison of BP daily log returns: Kaggle vs Yahoo Finance (2024)",
  align = c("l", "r")
)
```

## Forecast Accuracy using Different time horizons

### Forecast Setup

```{r fh-fixed-setup, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

fh_needed <- c("data_list", "Chosen_Stock", "dates", "prices", "start_date",
               "end_date", "mu_hat", "sigma_hat", "trading_days",
               "n_simulations")
fh_missing <- fh_needed[!vapply(fh_needed, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)]
if (length(fh_missing) > 0) {
  stop("Run the preceding single-stock chunks first. Missing: ",
       paste(fh_missing, collapse = ", "))
}
# choose parameters

fh_stock <- Chosen_Stock
fh_mu <- mu_hat
fh_sigma <- sigma_hat
fh_trading_days <- trading_days
fh_n_simulations <- 5000
fh_training_start <- as.Date(start_date)
fh_training_end <- as.Date(end_date)
fh_horizons <- c(5L, 21L, 63L, 126L, 252L)
fh_forecast_days <- max(fh_horizons)

# check filters
if (length(dates) != length(prices) || length(prices) < 30L ||
    anyNA(dates) || any(!is.finite(prices)) || any(prices <= 0)) {
  stop("The preceding single-stock dates/prices are missing or invalid.")
}
if (is.unsorted(dates) || min(dates) < fh_training_start ||
    max(dates) > fh_training_end) {
  stop("The dates/prices objects do not match the selected training period. Run choose-initial-stock again.")
}
if (!is.finite(fh_mu) || !is.finite(fh_sigma) || fh_sigma <= 0 ||
    !is.finite(fh_trading_days) || fh_trading_days <= 0 ||
    !is.finite(fh_n_simulations) || fh_n_simulations < 2) {
  stop("The existing fixed GBM parameters or simulation settings are invalid.")
}

fh_origin_date <- tail(dates, 1)
fh_S0 <- tail(prices, 1)

fh_stock_data <- data_list[[fh_stock]]
if (is.null(fh_stock_data) ||
    !all(c("date", "close") %in% names(fh_stock_data))) {
  stop("Could not find 'date' and 'close' for the selected stock in data_list.")
}
fh_all_dates <- as.Date(fh_stock_data$date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
fh_all_prices <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(fh_stock_data$close)))
fh_future_keep <- !is.na(fh_all_dates) & is.finite(fh_all_prices) &
  fh_all_prices > 0 & fh_all_dates > fh_origin_date
fh_future <- data.frame(
  Date = fh_all_dates[fh_future_keep],
  Price = fh_all_prices[fh_future_keep]
)
fh_future <- fh_future[order(fh_future$Date), , drop = FALSE]
# Keep one observation per date in the forecast dataset.
fh_future <- fh_future[!duplicated(fh_future$Date, fromLast = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
rownames(fh_future) <- NULL

if (nrow(fh_future) < fh_forecast_days) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Only %d subseqent valid trading-day prices exist after %s; %d are required.",
    nrow(fh_future), as.character(fh_origin_date), fh_forecast_days
  ))
}

# 252 subseqent days forecasted
fh_future <- fh_future[seq_len(fh_forecast_days), , drop = FALSE]
fh_forecast_dates <- c(fh_origin_date, fh_future$Date)
fh_actual_prices <- c(fh_S0, fh_future$Price)
fh_time <- (0:fh_forecast_days) / fh_trading_days

cat("Stock:", fh_stock, "\n")
cat("Training dates:", as.character(min(dates)), "to",
    as.character(fh_origin_date), "\n")
cat("Out-of-sample evaluation ends:",
    as.character(tail(fh_forecast_dates, 1)), "\n")
cat("Fixed annualised drift:", round(fh_mu, 4), "\n")
cat("Fixed annualised volatility:", round(fh_sigma, 4), "\n")
cat("Simulation paths:", fh_n_simulations, "\n")
```

### 5000 Simulations over 252 subsequent trading days

run simulation for the 252 subsequent trading days

```{r fh-fixed-simulate, echo=TRUE}
set.seed(123)
fh_daily_increments <- matrix(
  rnorm(
    fh_forecast_days * fh_n_simulations,
    mean = (fh_mu - 0.5 * fh_sigma^2) / fh_trading_days,
    sd = fh_sigma / sqrt(fh_trading_days)
  ),
  nrow = fh_forecast_days,
  ncol = fh_n_simulations
)

fh_simulated_prices <- rbind(
  rep(fh_S0, fh_n_simulations),
  fh_S0 * exp(apply(fh_daily_increments, 2, cumsum))
)

# exepcted price
fh_expected <- fh_S0 * exp(fh_mu * fh_time)
fh_z95 <- qnorm(0.975)
fh_lower95 <- fh_S0 * exp(
  (fh_mu - 0.5 * fh_sigma^2) * fh_time -
    fh_z95 * fh_sigma * sqrt(fh_time)
)
fh_upper95 <- fh_S0 * exp(
  (fh_mu - 0.5 * fh_sigma^2) * fh_time +
    fh_z95 * fh_sigma * sqrt(fh_time)
)

fh_trajectory <- data.frame(
  Date = fh_forecast_dates,
  Day = 0:fh_forecast_days,
  Observed = fh_actual_prices,
  Expected = fh_expected,
  Lower95 = fh_lower95,
  Upper95 = fh_upper95
)
fh_simulations_long <- data.frame(
  Date = rep(fh_forecast_dates, fh_n_simulations),
  Price = as.vector(fh_simulated_prices),
  Path = rep(seq_len(fh_n_simulations), each = length(fh_forecast_dates))
)
fh_markers <- fh_trajectory[fh_horizons + 1L, , drop = FALSE]

```

```{r fh-fixed-paths-plot, echo=TRUE, fig.height=6.5, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%"}

library(ggplot2)

fh_simulated_mean <- rowMeans(fh_simulated_prices)

# 500 paths for display
set.seed(456)

fh_display_ids <- sample(
  seq_len(ncol(fh_simulated_prices)),
  size = 500
)

fh_display_matrix <- fh_simulated_prices[
  , fh_display_ids, drop = FALSE
]

fh_display_long <- data.frame(
  Date = rep(fh_forecast_dates, times = 500),
  Price = as.vector(fh_display_matrix),
  Path = rep(
    seq_len(500),
    each = length(fh_forecast_dates)
  )
)

fh_mean_data <- data.frame(Date = fh_forecast_dates,Mean = fh_simulated_mean)

fh_path_plot <- ggplot() +
  
  # 95% prediction interval
  geom_ribbon(data = fh_trajectory,aes(x = Date,ymin = Lower95,ymax = Upper95,fill = "95% prediction interval"),alpha = 0.22)+
  # Display 500 paths
  geom_line(
    data = fh_display_long,
    aes(
      x = Date,
      y = Price,
      group = Path,
      colour = "500 simulated GBM paths"
    ),
    alpha = 0.055,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # Set horizons
  geom_vline(
    data = fh_markers,
    aes(
      xintercept = as.numeric(Date),
      linetype = "Forecast horizons"
    ),
    colour = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Mean of  simulations
  geom_line(
    data = fh_mean_data,
    aes(
      x = Date,
      y = Mean,
      colour = "Mean of 5000 paths"
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  # historical prices
  geom_line(
    data = fh_trajectory,
    aes(
      x = Date,
      y = Observed,
      colour = "Observed historical price"
    ),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  
  # Prices at forecast horizon
  geom_point(
    data = fh_markers,
    aes(x = Date, y = Observed),
    colour = "red",
    fill = "white",
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.6,
    stroke = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # Legend colours
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    breaks = c(
      "500 simulated GBM paths",
      "Mean of 5000 paths",
      "Observed historical price"
    ),
    values = c(
      "500 simulated GBM paths" = "blue",
      "Mean of 5000 paths" = "#17365D",
      "Observed historical price" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "95% prediction interval" = "#A7C9EC"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Forecast horizons" = "dotted"
    )
  ) +
  
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1,
        linewidth = 1.1
      )
    ),
    fill = guide_legend(order = 2),
    linetype = guide_legend(order = 3)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = paste(
      fh_stock,
      ": Fixed-Parameter GBM Forecasts"
    ),
    subtitle = paste(
      "5000 paths simulated, 500 displayed over 252 trading days"
    ),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Closing price"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.98),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.85),
      colour = "grey80"
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(fh_path_plot)
```

### Accuracy of the different time horizons

```{r fh-fixed-accuracy-table, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(gt)

fh_idx <- fh_horizons + 1L

fh_actual_at_h <- fh_actual_prices[fh_idx]
fh_expected_at_h <- fh_expected[fh_idx]

fh_results <- data.frame(
  Horizon_Days = fh_horizons,
  Date = fh_forecast_dates[fh_idx],
  Actual_Price = fh_actual_at_h,
  GBM_Expected_Price = fh_expected_at_h,
  GBM_APE = 100 * abs(fh_expected_at_h - fh_actual_at_h) / fh_actual_at_h,
  NoChange_APE = 100 * abs(fh_S0 - fh_actual_at_h) / fh_actual_at_h,
  Inside_95_Interval = fh_actual_at_h >= fh_lower95[fh_idx] & fh_actual_at_h <= fh_upper95[fh_idx]
)

fh_display <- data.frame(Horizon = fh_results$Horizon_Days,Forecast_Date = format(fh_results$Date, "%d/%m/%y"),
  Actual_Close = fh_results$Actual_Price,
  GBM_Close = fh_results$GBM_Expected_Price,
  GBM_APE = fh_results$GBM_APE,
  NoChange_APE = fh_results$NoChange_APE,
  Inside_95 = ifelse(fh_results$Inside_95_Interval,"Yes", "No")
)

# Match format to industry summary
fh_table <- gt::gt(fh_display) |>
  
  gt::tab_header(
    title = paste(
      "Forecast Horizon Summary:", fh_stock
    )
  ) |>
  
  gt::cols_label(
    Horizon = gt::html("Horizon<br>(days)"),
    Forecast_Date = "Forecast date",
    Actual_Close = "Actual close",
    GBM_Close = gt::html("GBM expected<br>close"),
    GBM_APE = gt::html("GBM APE<br>(%)"),
    NoChange_APE = gt::html("No-change APE<br>(%)"),
    Inside_95 = gt::html("Inside 95%<br>interval?")
  ) |>
  
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(
      Actual_Close,
      GBM_Close,
      GBM_APE,
      NoChange_APE
    ),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  
  gt::cols_width(
    Horizon ~ gt::px(70),
    Forecast_Date ~ gt::px(90),
    Actual_Close ~ gt::px(95),
    GBM_Close ~ gt::px(105),
    GBM_APE ~ gt::px(80),
    NoChange_APE ~ gt::px(105),
    Inside_95 ~ gt::px(85)
  ) |>
  
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = Horizon
  ) |>
  
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "right",
    columns = c(
      Actual_Close,
      GBM_Close,
      GBM_APE,
      NoChange_APE
    )
  ) |>
  
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(
      Forecast_Date,
      Inside_95
    )
  ) |>
  
# table style
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    table.font.names = "Arial",
    table.font.size = gt::px(11),
    table.font.color = "#686868",
    data_row.padding = gt::px(5),
    heading.align = "center",
    heading.title.font.size = gt::px(15),
    heading.title.font.weight = "normal",
    column_labels.font.size = gt::px(11),
    column_labels.font.weight = "normal",
    table_body.hlines.color = "#D9D9D9"
  ) |>
  
  # Grey centred title
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
      color = "#666666"
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_title(
      groups = "title"
    )
  )
fh_table
```

## Comparison of Different Sectors

Mean Annualised Volatility

```{r comparison-volatility-graph, echo=TRUE, fig.height=7, fig.width=11, out.width="100%"}

library(ggplot2)

# volatility of each period

vol_2020 <- period_results[["2020"]]$industry_summary
vol_2024 <- period_results[["2024"]]$industry_summary

volatility_data <- merge(
  data.frame(
    Industry = vol_2020$Industry,
    Volatility_2020 = vol_2020$Annualised_Volatility * 100
  ),
  data.frame(
    Industry = vol_2024$Industry,
    Volatility_2024 = vol_2024$Annualised_Volatility * 100
  ),
  by = "Industry"
)

# filter

volatility_data <- volatility_data[
  complete.cases(volatility_data),
]

volatility_data$Industry <- factor(
  volatility_data$Industry,
  levels = volatility_data$Industry[
    order(volatility_data$Volatility_2020)
  ]
)

volatility_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    Industry = volatility_data$Industry,
    Year = "2020",
    Volatility = volatility_data$Volatility_2020
  ),
  data.frame(
    Industry = volatility_data$Industry,
    Year = "2024",
    Volatility = volatility_data$Volatility_2024
  )
)

volatility_long$Year <- factor(
  volatility_long$Year,
  levels = c("2020", "2024")
)

# dumbell plot

volatility_dumbbell <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_segment(
    data = volatility_data,
    aes(
      x = Volatility_2020,
      xend = Volatility_2024,
      y = Industry,
      yend = Industry
    ),
    colour = "grey60",
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = volatility_long,
    aes(
      x = Volatility,
      y = Industry,
      colour = Year
    ),
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "2020" = "blue",
      "2024" = "red"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.08))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Mean Annualised Volatility by Industry",
    subtitle = "Comparison between 2020 and 2024",
```

```{r kurtosis-qq-comparison, echo=TRUE, fig.height=9, fig.width=13, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%"}

library(ggplot2)

# Find industries with highest and lowest excess kurtosis

kurtosis_summary <- period_results[["2024"]]$distribution_comparison

kurtosis_summary <- kurtosis_summary[
  is.finite(kurtosis_summary$Mean_Absolute_Excess_Kurtosis),
]

highest_industry <- kurtosis_summary$Industry[
  which.max(kurtosis_summary$Mean_Absolute_Excess_Kurtosis)
]

lowest_industry <- kurtosis_summary$Industry[
  which.min(kurtosis_summary$Mean_Absolute_Excess_Kurtosis)
]

selected_industries <- c(highest_industry, lowest_industry)

print(selected_industries)


# calculate daily log returns

get_industry_returns <- function(industry, year) {
  
  start <- as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"))
  end <- as.Date(paste0(year, "-12-31"))
  
  tickers <- intersect(
    industry_tickers[[industry]],
    names(data_list)
  )
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (ticker in tickers) {
    
    stock <- data_list[[ticker]]
    
    if (!all(c("date", "close") %in% names(stock))) next
    
    dates <- as.Date(stock$date)
    prices <- suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(stock$close))
    )
    
    valid <- !is.na(dates) &
      dates >= start &
      dates <= end &
      is.finite(prices) &
      prices > 0
    
    dates <- dates[valid]
    prices <- prices[valid]
    
    if (length(prices) < 30) next
    
    prices <- prices[order(dates)]
    
    returns <- diff(log(prices))
    returns <- returns[is.finite(returns)]
    
    if (length(returns) < 20) next
    
    volatility <- sd(returns)
    
    if (!is.finite(volatility) || volatility == 0) next
    
    # returns for each stock and year
    
    z_returns <- (returns - mean(returns)) / volatility
    
    results[[ticker]] <- data.frame(
      Industry = industry,
      Period = year,
      Standardised_Return = z_returns
    )
  }
  
  if (length(results) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  do.call(rbind, results)
}


# returns for both industries and both periods

plot_data <- list()

for (industry in selected_industries) {
  
  for (year in c("2020", "2024")) {
    
    result <- get_industry_returns(industry, year)
    
    if (!is.null(result)) {
      plot_data[[paste(industry, year)]] <- result
    }
  }
}

if (length(plot_data) == 0) {
  stop("No eligible return data found.")
}

plot_data <- do.call(rbind, plot_data)

# order of industries and years

plot_data$Industry <- factor(
  plot_data$Industry,
  levels = selected_industries
)

plot_data$Period <- factor(
  plot_data$Period,
  levels = c("2020", "2024")
)


# Create four Q-Q plot

qq_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(sample = Standardised_Return,colour = Period)) +
  stat_qq(size = 0.8,alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1,intercept = 0,colour = "black",linetype = "dashed",linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Industry),cols = vars(Period),scales = "fixed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("2020" = "blue","2024" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Normal Q-Q Plots by Industry",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Standardised daily log returns:", "2020 compared with 2024"),
    x = "Theoretical Normal Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles",
    caption = "Dashed black line: Standard Normal Distribution N(0,1)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 19),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95",colour = NA),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1, "cm"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey40")
  )

print(qq_plot)
```

### Hypothesis testing of GBM Assumptions

#### Jarque-Bera Normality Test

```{r Jarque-Bera-Test-for-Normality, echo=TRUE}

jb_industries <- list("Business Services and Building Products" =c("HWDN", "RTO", "RMV"),
  "Property and Housebuilding" =c("BBOX", "BLND", "BTRW", "LAND","LMP", "PSN", "SGRO")
)

jb_years <- c(2020, 2024)
jb_alpha <- 0.05
jb_min_returns <- 100

jb_results <- list()

for (industry in names(jb_industries)) {
  
  for (ticker in jb_industries[[industry]]) {
    
    if (!ticker %in% names(data_list)) {
      message("Stock not found: ", ticker)
      next
    }
    
    stock <- data_list[[ticker]]
    
    if (!all(c("date", "close") %in% names(stock))) {
      message("Missing columns: ", ticker)
      next
    }
    
    stock$date <- as.Date(stock$date)
    stock$close <- as.numeric(stock$close)
    
    for (year in jb_years) {
      
      # Filter to selected year
      df <- stock[
        !is.na(stock$date) &
          format(stock$date, "%Y") == as.character(year) &
          is.finite(stock$close) &
          stock$close > 0,
      ]
      
      df <- df[order(df$date), ]
      df <- df[!duplicated(df$date), ]
      
      returns <- diff(log(df$close))
      
      if (length(returns) < jb_min_returns) next
      
      if (!is.finite(sd(returns)) ||
          sd(returns) == 0) next
      
      test <- tseries::jarque.bera.test(returns)
      
      jb_results[[length(jb_results) + 1]] <-
        data.frame(
          Industry = industry,
          Ticker = ticker,
          Year = year,
          JB_Statistic = as.numeric(test$statistic),
          P_Value = test$p.value,
          Reject_Normality = test$p.value < jb_alpha
        )
    }
  }
}

if (length(jb_results) == 0) {
  stop("No valid stock data found for the JB tests.")
}

jb_stock_results <- do.call(rbind, jb_results)

# individual stock results
print(jb_stock_results)

#aggregate results

jb_summary_long <- aggregate(
  Reject_Normality ~ Industry + Year,
  data = jb_stock_results,
  FUN = function(x) c(
    Tested = length(x),
    Rejected = sum(x)
  )
)

jb_summary_long <- data.frame(
  Industry = jb_summary_long$Industry,
  Year = jb_summary_long$Year,
  Tested = jb_summary_long$Reject_Normality[, "Tested"],
  Rejected = jb_summary_long$Reject_Normality[, "Rejected"]
)

jb_summary_long$Rejection_Rate <-
  100 * jb_summary_long$Rejected /
  jb_summary_long$Tested

#create table

format_jb_result <- function(industry, year) {
  
  df <- jb_summary_long[
    jb_summary_long$Industry == industry &
      jb_summary_long$Year == year,
  ]
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return("No data")
  
  sprintf(
    "%d/%d (%.1f%%)",
    df$Rejected,
    df$Tested,
    df$Rejection_Rate
  )
}

jb_comparison <- data.frame(
  Industry = names(jb_industries),
  
  P1 = sapply(
    names(jb_industries),
    function(x) format_jb_result(x, 2020)
  ),
  
  P2 = sapply(
    names(jb_industries),
    function(x) format_jb_result(x, 2024)
  ),
  
  row.names = NULL
)

jb_table <- gt(jb_comparison) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Jarque-Bera Normality Test",
    subtitle = "Percentage of stocks rejecting normality"
  ) |>
  cols_label(Industry = "Industry",P1 = "2020",P2 = "2024"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "center",columns = c(P1, P2)
  ) |>
  cols_width(Industry ~ px(300),P1 ~ px(160),P2 ~ px(160)
  ) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14),data_row.padding = px(8),heading.title.font.size = px(17),heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12)
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(source_note ="Rejected / tested (percentage); significance level = 5%.")

print(jb_table)

#save results in tex format
write.csv(jb_stock_results,"jb_stock_results.csv",row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(jb_summary_long,"jb_industry_summary.csv",row.names = FALSE)
gtsave(jb_table,"jb_normality_table.tex")

#(earlier results were saved using console commands)
```

#### ARCH Test for Volatility Clustering

```{r ARCH-test, echo=TRUE}
library(gt)


arch_industries <- list("Business Services and Building Products" =c("HWDN", "RTO", "RMV"),
  "Property and Housebuilding" =c("BBOX", "BLND", "BTRW", "LAND","LMP", "PSN", "SGRO")
)

arch_years <- c(2020, 2024)
arch_alpha <- 0.05
arch_lags <- 10
arch_min_returns <- 100

arch_lm_test <- function(returns, lags = 10) {
  
  residuals <- returns - mean(returns)
  squared_residuals <- residuals^2
  
  n <- length(squared_residuals)
  
  if (n <= lags + 1) {
    stop("Not enough observations for ARCH-LM test.")
  }
  
  y <- squared_residuals[(lags + 1):n]
  
  x <- sapply(
    1:lags,
    function(i) {
      squared_residuals[
        (lags + 1 - i):(n - i)
      ]
    }
  )
  
  model <- lm(y ~ x)
  
  if (model$rank < lags + 1) {
    stop("ARCH auxiliary regression is rank deficient.")
  }
  LM <- length(y) * summary(model)$r.squared
  
  p_value <- pchisq(
    LM,
    df = lags,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )
  
  list(
    statistic = LM,
    p.value = p_value
  )
}

#test for each stock each year

arch_results <- list()

for (industry in names(arch_industries)) {
  
  for (ticker in arch_industries[[industry]]) {
    
    if (!ticker %in% names(data_list)) {
      message("Stock not found: ", ticker)
      next
    }
    
    stock <- data_list[[ticker]]
    
    if (!all(c("date", "close") %in% names(stock))) {
      message("Missing columns: ", ticker)
      next
    }
    
    stock$date <- as.Date(stock$date)
    stock$close <- as.numeric(
      as.character(stock$close)
    )
    
    for (year in arch_years) {
      
      df <- stock[
        !is.na(stock$date) &
          format(stock$date, "%Y") == as.character(year) &
          is.finite(stock$close) &
          stock$close > 0,
      ]
      
      df <- df[order(df$date), ]
      df <- df[!duplicated(df$date), ]
      
      returns <- diff(log(df$close))
      
      if (length(returns) < arch_min_returns) next
      
      if (!is.finite(sd(returns)) ||
          sd(returns) == 0) next
      
      # test
      test <- tryCatch(
        arch_lm_test(returns, arch_lags),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (is.null(test)) next
      
      arch_results[[length(arch_results) + 1]] <-
        data.frame(
          Industry = industry,
          Ticker = ticker,
          Year = year,
          ARCH_Statistic = test$statistic,
          P_Value = test$p.value,
          Reject_No_ARCH = test$p.value < arch_alpha
        )
    }
  }
}

if (length(arch_results) == 0) {
  stop("No valid stock data found for ARCH tests.")
}

arch_stock_results <- do.call(rbind,arch_results)

#individual results
print(arch_stock_results)

#agg results

arch_summary_long <- aggregate(
  Reject_No_ARCH ~ Industry + Year,
  data = arch_stock_results,
  FUN = function(x) c(
    Tested = length(x),
    Rejected = sum(x)
  )
)

arch_summary_long <- data.frame(
  Industry = arch_summary_long$Industry,
  Year = arch_summary_long$Year,
  Tested = arch_summary_long$Reject_No_ARCH[, "Tested"],
  Rejected = arch_summary_long$Reject_No_ARCH[, "Rejected"]
)

arch_summary_long$Rejection_Rate <-
  100 * arch_summary_long$Rejected /
  arch_summary_long$Tested

#create table

format_arch_result <- function(industry, year) {
  
  df <- arch_summary_long[
    arch_summary_long$Industry == industry &
      arch_summary_long$Year == year,
  ]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return("No data")
  sprintf(
    "%d/%d (%.1f%%)",df$Rejected,df$Tested,df$Rejection_Rate)
}
arch_comparison <- data.frame(
  Industry = names(arch_industries),
  P1 = sapply(
    names(arch_industries),
    function(x) format_arch_result(x, 2020)
  ),
  P2 = sapply(
    names(arch_industries),
    function(x) format_arch_result(x, 2024)
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

arch_table <- gt(arch_comparison) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "ARCH-LM Test for Volatility Clustering",
    subtitle = "Percentage of stocks rejecting no ARCH effects"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    Industry = "Industry",P1 = "2020",P2 = "2024"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "center",columns = c(P1, P2)
  ) |>
  cols_width(Industry ~ px(300),P1 ~ px(160),P2 ~ px(160)
  ) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14), data_row.padding = px(8),
    heading.title.font.size = px(17), heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12)
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(source_note ="Rejected / tested (percentage); 10 lags; significance level = 5%.")
print(arch_table)

#save table as tex
write.csv(arch_stock_results, "arch_stock_results.csv",row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(arch_summary_long,"arch_industry_summary.csv",row.names = FALSE)
gtsave(arch_table,"arch_volatility_table.tex")

```
